title: Antigua Penthouse | Rosemary Beach Condo | 30A Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: The Antigua Penthouse is the perfect 2 bedroom Rosemary Beach condo for your next getaway. Enjoy stunning gulf views, a fully equipped kitchen and much more! Book here!
description_expanded:
Newly remodeled kitchen and more for 2025! The Antigua Penthouse offers the closest and best gulf view of any Two Bedroom condo in Rosemary Beach. This clean and well cared for condo offers stunning Gulf Views as your backdrop from multiple balconies. On the entry level, you'll find the master bedroom (king), bath with soaker tub and shower. The master bedroom offers a private sitting balcony overlooking picturesque Main Street and The Pearl Hotel. The 2nd bedroom (queen, twin trundle) faces west and has its own on-suite bathroom and balcony. The upper floor of this two-level condo is the newly remodeled kitchen. Glass balcony doors flank both sides of the dining and living areas. In the living room enjoy comfortable seating and a cozy fireplace while watching your favorite sporting event on the big screen TV.

Our sunrise east balcony offers stunning Western Green and Gulf Views. The sunset west balcony offers relaxed seating as well as mesmerizing Florida sunsets.

The Antigua Penthouse resides on the 3rd & 4th floors of a four-story commercial building in the heart of Rosemary Beach's olde world village. A fine art gallery is on the ground level and fronts Main Street. Next door is Edwards Cafe as well as the Summer Kitchen cafe. Across the street is the Pearl Hotel and Bar. An elevator adjacent to your reserved parking space opens to the Antigua Penthouse front door (third floor). Once inside the condo, stairs are required to access the upper level living areas (fourth floor). Enjoy an unforgettable stay at the Antigua Penthouse!

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

One reserved parking space in rear.

Elevator to third floor front door, interior stairs required to access fourth floor kitchen and living areas.

Third Level:

Bedroom 1 with King

Bedroom 2 with Queen with a pull-out twin trundle.

Fourth Level:

Kitchen, Dining, Living areas and two expansive balconies.

Main Level: Art Gallery

Second Level: Antigua Blue Condo 1 BR (rented separately)
